bind_address.description: IP address(es) Redis binds to (space-separated). Use '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces (not recommended without firewall).

unix_socket_path.description: Unix socket path for local connections. Leave empty to disable.

unix_socket_perms.description: Unix socket file permissions (octal). Only used if unix_socket_path is set.

timeout.description: Close connection after N seconds of inactivity (0 = disable timeout).

tcp_keepalive.description: Send TCP keepalive every N seconds (0 = disable).

daemonize.description: Run as a background daemon (set to true only if managed by supervisor/systemd).

log_file.description: Path to log file (use 'stdout' for console logging).

syslog_ident.description: Syslog program name (only used if syslog_enabled=true).

rdb_snapshots.description: RDB snapshot intervals (save <seconds> <keys>). Each object defines when to persist the dataset to disk.

keys_changed.description: Number of key changes required to trigger snapshot.

rdb_dir.description: Directory where RDB files are stored.

stop_writes_on_bgsave_error.description: Stop accepting writes if background save fails (prevents data loss).

rdb_compression.description: Compress RDB files (use 'no' for high-throughput workloads with CPU bottleneck).

rdb_checksum.description: Enable RDB file checksum for integrity verification.

aof_enabled.description: Enable Append-Only File (AOF) persistence for durability.

aof_fsync_policy.description: How often to sync AOF to disk. 'everysec' balances durability and performance.

no_aof_fsync_on_rewrite.description: Avoid syncing during AOF rewrite (useful for high-load systems).

auto_aof_rewrite_percentage.description: Trigger AOF rewrite when size grows by this percentage since last rewrite.

auto_aof_rewrite_min_size.description: Minimum AOF size required to trigger rewrite (supports suffixes: kb, mb, gb).

aof_load_truncated.description: Load truncated AOF files on startup (prevents crash on corruption).

aof_use_rdb_preamble.description: Use RDB preamble in AOF (improves restart time for large datasets).

max_memory.description: Max memory Redis can use (0 = unlimited). Supports suffixes: kb, mb, gb.

max_memory_policy.description: Eviction policy when max_memory is reached.

max_memory_samples.description: Number of keys to sample for LRU/LFU eviction (higher = more accurate but slower).

lazyfree_lazy_eviction.description: Use lazy free (background thread) for eviction (improves latency under memory pressure).

lazyfree_lazy_expire.description: Use lazy free for expired keys.

lazyfree_lazy_server_del.description: Use lazy free for DEL commands.

replica_lazy_flush.description: Use lazy flush on replica during sync.

latency_monitor_threshold.description: Log events with latency > N ms (0 = disable latency monitoring).

require_password.description: Password for AUTH command (empty = no authentication).

client_output_buffer_limits.description: Per-client-class buffer limits (hard, soft limits in bytes + timeout).

hard.description: Hard buffer limit (immediate disconnect if exceeded).

soft.description: Soft buffer limit (disconnect after N seconds).

acl_file.description: Path to ACL file (if using Redis ACLs).

default_user.description: Default user configuration: 'disabled' = off, 'on' = requirepass, 'off' = no auth.

slowlog_max_len.description: Max number of slow log entries to retain.

notify_keyspace_events.description: Event notifications (e.g., 'AKE' = all events, empty = disabled).

hash_max_entries.description: Max entries in hash before switching to hashtable.

hash_max_value.description: Max value size in hash before switching to hashtable (bytes).

list_compress_depth.description: Number of quicklist nodes to compress (0 = none).

set_max_entries.description: Max entries in set before switching to intset.

zset_max_entries.description: Max entries in sorted set before switching to ziplist.

zset_max_value.description: Max value size in sorted set before switching to ziplist (bytes).

stream_node_max_bytes.description: Max bytes in stream node before splitting.

stream_node_max_entries.description: Max entries in stream node before splitting.

active_rehashing.description: Incrementally rehash keys in background (improves latency).

client_query_buffer_limit.description: Max query buffer per client (supports suffixes: kb, mb, gb).

proto_max_bulk_len.description: Max bulk request size (supports suffixes: kb, mb, gb).

hz.description: Server frequency for internal tasks (higher = more responsive but more CPU).

dynamic_hz.description: Auto-adjust hz based on load (improves CPU efficiency).

aof_rewrite_incremental_fsync.description: Sync AOF rewrite in chunks to reduce latency spikes.

rdb_save_incremental_fsync.description: Sync RDB save in chunks to reduce latency spikes.
